english_title: Euler's Theorem on the Sum of Prime Reciprocals
statement_en: Let $\mathbb{P}$ be the set of prime numbers. The series $$\sum_{p\in \mathbb{P}} \frac{1}{p}$$ diverges.
final_code:
import Mathlib

theorem prime_reciprocals_not_summable :
    ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => if Nat.Prime n then (1 : ℝ) / n else 0) := by
  sorry
